Actions.Name: Fleet Pulse
Actions.Tooltip: Live T3 Code fleet counts; press to focus and open the highest-priority thread needing you.

Actions.Name: Approve / Answer
Actions.Tooltip: Short press: approve pending permission (or open pending question). Hold: approve for session.

Actions.Name: Stop / Deny
Actions.Tooltip: Short press: decline pending approval or interrupt active run. Hold: force-stop thread.

Actions.Name: Settle / Pin
Actions.Tooltip: Short press: toggle Settle on focused thread. Hold: toggle Pin.

Actions.Name: New Chat
Actions.Tooltip: Open a new T3 Code composer.

Actions.Name: Send / Steer Prompt
Actions.Tooltip: Send or steer a configurable prompt to the focused T3 thread. Hold to open thread.

Actions.Name: Open Thread / PR
Actions.Tooltip: Short press: focus thread in T3 Code. Hold: open linked Pull Request.

Actions.Name: Snooze / Sync
Actions.Tooltip: Short press: snooze focused thread for 1 hour (or unsnooze). Hold: reconnect and resync.

Actions.Name: Thread Slot
Actions.Tooltip: Displays and opens the thread at this key's slot index.

TriggerDescription.Push: Open focused thread in T3 Code
TriggerDescription.Touch: Cycle filter (Active / Attention / Running / Pinned / All)

Actions.Name: Thread Navigator
Actions.Tooltip: Scrub T3 Code threads across all projects with live status, project, and PR badges.

TriggerDescription.Push: Apply selected model (or hold/press when idle to toggle Favorites vs All)
TriggerDescription.Rotate: Browse Favorite models (or All models when toggled)
TriggerDescription.Touch: Apply selected model (or tap when idle to toggle Favorites vs All)

Actions.Name: Model & Provider
Actions.Tooltip: Switch models and providers (Claude, Codex, Antigravity, OpenCode) on the focused thread.

TriggerDescription.Push: Cycle runtime mode (Ask / Edits / Auto / Full)

Actions.Name: Mode & Effort
Actions.Tooltip: Adjust reasoning effort, runtime permissions, and Plan Mode on the focused thread.

Actions.Name: Usage Radar
Actions.Tooltip: Live session and weekly utilization gauges across all connected T3 Code providers.

Author: Charles Bine
Description: Real-time T3 Code mission control for Stream Deck+: live approvals, thread navigation, multi-provider model/effort/mode switching, and usage gauges.
Name: T3 Deck
